title: Step 11 — the initiator locks 5,000,000 tCeBM on spoke-crc, timelock now+3600
description: Banco de San Jose locks the CRC leg. The gateway generates a 32-byte secret internally, derives hash_lock = SHA-256(secret) and returns both. Only the initiator ever holds the secret.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway (spoke-crc). Locked at 2026-06-18T10:15:00Z, time_lock 1781781300 = 2026-06-18T11:15:00Z (now+3600, the default). SAFETY-CRITICAL: this timelock MUST be longer than the responder's 1781779800 in mock-pvp-hp-12. Nothing in any schema enforces it; inverting the two models an unsafe swap in which the initiator can claim the responder's leg after the responder has lost the ability to refund. agreement_id carries an FX trade_id despite its name; receiver must be on the local spoke or the lock is rejected. Divergence, verified in the delivered gateway (LockHTLCResult): the 201 body also carries secret, which contracts/pvp does not declare — it is returned exactly once and never re-exposed. hash_lock is bare 64-character hex with no 0x prefix: the responder endpoint hex-decodes it and rejects anything that is not exactly 32 bytes, so the 0x-prefixed and 66-character examples in the platform document cannot be sent literally.
